40016133.author: पदार्थः
40016133.content: महाबलः mighty, राक्षसः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, बलस्य army, विघातेन destruction, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, जयेनच victory, क्रोधम् enraged, अविष्टः became

40016133.author: Translation
40016133.content: Vajradamshtra, the mighty Rakshasa became enraged with the destruction of his army and victory of Angada.

40016134.author: पदार्थः
40016134.content: शक्राशनिसमप्रभम् had the splendour of Indra's thunderbolt, घोरम् terrific, धनुः bow, विस्फार्यः stretching, वानराणाम् at Vanaras, अनीकानि army troops, शरवृष्टिभिः showers of shafts, प्राकिरत् assailed.

40016134.author: Translation
40016134.content: Stretching his terrific bow which had the splendour of Indra's bow he (Vajradamshtra) showered shafts at the army troops of Vanaras and assailed them.

40016135.author: पदार्थः
40016135.content: रथेषु at chariots, समवस्थिताः seated, मुख्याः chief, ते they, शूराः heroes, राक्षसाश्चापि Rakshasas also, नानाप्रहरणाः different weapons, तदा then, रणे in the combat, प्रायुध्यन्त fought steadily.

40016135.author: Translation
40016135.content: Seated firmly on the chariots the chiefs and heroes of Rakshasas also fought steadily with different weapons in the combat.

40016136.author: पदार्थः
40016136.content: वानराणाम् Vanaras, शूराः warriors, येसर्वे all, तेप्लवगोत्तमाः best of Vanaras, समनत्तः together, समवेताः gathered, शिलाहस्ताः with rocks in hand, अयुद्यन्त contended.

40016136.author: Translation
40016136.content: The best of Vanara warriors also gathered together with rocks in hand contended.

40016137.author: पदार्थः
40016137.content: तदा then, तत्र there, तस्मिन् in that, अयोधने battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, कपिमुख्येषु with chiefs of Vanaras, आयुधसहस्राणि thousands of missiles, भृशम् instantly, पातयांचक्रिरे went hurling.

40016137.author: Translation
40016137.content: Then in that battle the Rakshasas went on hurling thousands of missiles at the chiefs of Vanaras.

40016138.author: पदार्थः
40016138.content: प्रवीराः heroic, मत्तमातङ्गसन्निभाः who resembled elephants in rut, वानराश्चैव Vanaras also, रक्षःसु at Rakshasas, गिरिवृक्षान् mountains and trees, महाशिलाः huge rocks, पातयामासुः showered.

40016138.author: Translation
40016138.content: Heroic Vanaras who resembled elephants in rut showered mountains and trees and huge rocks at Rakshasas.

40016139.author: पदार्थः
40016139.content: शूराणाम् between heroes, युद्यमानाम् fighting, समरेषु battle, अनिवर्तिनाम् never returned, राक्षसगणानाम् Rakshasa troops, तत् then, सुयुद्धम् great struggle, समवर्तत happened.

40016139.author: Translation
40016139.content: Between the heroes fighting the battle, who never returned, Great War continued between Rakshasas troops and Vanaras.

40016140.author: पदार्थः
40016140.content: केचित् some, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसाश्चैव Rakshasas also, प्रभिन्नशिरसः heads severed, छिन्नैः broken, पादैः feet, बाहुभिः many, शस्त्रै weapons:, आर्दितदेहाः bodies mangled, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षिताः bathed in blood, कङ्कगृध्रावळैराढ्याश्च arms and feet looped over neck, गोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows, गाम् devolving, समाश्रिताः surrounded by, शेरते lay strewn.

40016140.author: Translation
40016140.content: There lay strewn some monkeys and Rakshasas also with severed heads, broken feet, with many weapons mangled with bodies, bathed in blood, arms and feet looped to necks devolving as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows surrounded.

40016141.author: पदार्थः
40016141.content: केचित् some, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसाश्चैव Rakshasas also, प्रभिन्नशिरसः heads severed, छिन्नैः broken, पादैः feet, बाहुभिः many, शस्त्रै weapons:, आर्दितदेहाः bodies mangled, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षिताः bathed in blood, कङ्कगृध्रावळैराढ्याश्च arms and feet looped over neck, गोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows, गाम् devolving, समाश्रिताः surrounded by, शेरते lay strewn.

40016141.author: Translation
40016141.content: There lay strewn some monkeys and Rakshasas also with severed heads, broken feet, with many weapons mangled with bodies, bathed in blood, arms and feet looped to necks devolving as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows surrounded.

40016142.author: पदार्थः
40016142.content: भीरूणाम् timid ones, भीषणानि headless trunks, कबन्धानि arms, भूतले on the ground, समुत्पेतुः gathered, भुजपाणिशिरछशिन्नाः with arms heads and hand s severed, छिन्नकायाश्च whose trunks were cut off, वानराः Vanara, राक्षसाश्चापि even Rakshasas, तत्र there, वैरणे in the battlefield, निपेतुः lay.

40016142.author: Translation
40016142.content: Then in the battlefield, the timid vanaras and even rakshasas with their arms and heads cut off, bodies wounded allover dropped down.

40016143.author: पदार्थः
40016143.content: ततः thereafter, निशाचरम् night rangers, सर्वंबलम् all army, वानरसैन्येन Vanara troops, हन्यमानम् killed, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradamshtra's, पश्यतः stood looking, प्राभज्यत ran helterskelter.

40016143.author: Translation
40016143.content: Thereafter Rakshasas were killed by Vanaras as Vajradamshtra kept looking at them and the Rakshasas ran from there.

40016144.author: पदार्थः
40016144.content: प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, हन्यमानान् struck by, भयवित्रस्तान् stricken with fear, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रतापवान् valiant, सः he, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, रोषताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, त्रासयन् terrifying, प्रविवेश penetrated.

40016144.author: Translation
40016144.content: Struck by monkeys the Rakshasas were in fear. Seeing the Rakshasas Vajraddamshtra's eyes turned red in anger with bow in hand penetrating the Vanara troops terrifying them.

40016145.author: पदार्थः
40016145.content: प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, हन्यमानान् struck by, भयवित्रस्तान् stricken with fear, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रतापवान् valiant, सः he, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, रोषताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, त्रासयन् terrifying, प्रविवेश penetrated.

40016145.author: Translation
40016145.content: Struck by monkeys the Rakshasas were in fear. Seeing the Rakshasas Vajraddamshtra's eyes turned red in anger with bow in hand penetrating the Vanara troops terrifying them.

40016146.author: पदार्थः
40016146.content: प्रतापवान् valiant one, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, परमक्रुद्धः very furious, कङ्कपत्रैः plumes of buzzard, अजिह्मगैः which never missed the target, शरैः arrows, तत्र there, सप्त seven, अष्टौ eight, नव nine, पञ्चच five also, वानरान् Vanaras, विव्याध struck them, विदारयामास pierced.

40016146.author: Translation
40016146.content: Valiant Vajradamshtra became very furious and pierced with arrows of plumes of buzzard which never missed target in seven, eight, nine and five Vanaras at a time.

40016147.author: पदार्थः
40016147.content: शरैः arrows, सङ्कृत्तकन्दरा: broken necks, सर्वे all, हरिगणाः Vanaras, त्रस्ताः out of fear, प्रजाः people, प्रजापतिमिव like creator Brahma, अङ्गदम् Angada, सम्प्रधावन्त sought protection.

40016147.author: Translation
40016147.content: Struck with fear the Vanaras sought the protection of Angada just as people seek protection of Brahma, the creator of beings.

40016148.author: पदार्थः
40016148.content: तदा then, वालिसुतः Vali's son, भग्नान् broken, हरिगणान् monkeys, दृष्टवा gazing, ततः then, उदीक्षन्तम् looking at them, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, क्रोधेन in anger, उदैक्षत faced himself.

40016148.author: Translation
40016148.content: Then the son of Vali gazing at the broken monkeys looking at Vajradamshtra in anger, faced himself.

40016149.author: पदार्थः
40016149.content: वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, अङ्गदश्च Angada's, उभौ both, हरिराक्षसौ monkeys and Rakshasas, सङ्गतौ strode, हरिमत्तगजामिव like lion and elephant in rut, परमक्रुद्धौ enraged, चेरतुः fought.

40016149.author: Translation
40016149.content: Vajradamshtra and Angada both enraged and strode among Rakshasas and monkeys and fought like a lion and intoxicated elephant.

40016150.author: पदार्थः
40016150.content: ततः then, महाबलः endowed with great strength, हरिपुत्रम् monkey 's son, शतसहस्रेण hundred thousand, मातङ्गमिवतोमरैः like an elephants is pierced with clubs, मर्मदेशेषु private parts, जघान pierced.

40016150.author: Translation
40016150.content: Then Angada endowed with great strength, pierced Vajradamshtra in his private parts with clubs used for piercing elephants.

40016151.author: पदार्थः
40016151.content: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः all limbs bathed in blood, महाबलः mighty, भीमपराक्रमः of terrific valour, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, वज्रदंष्ट्राय at Vajradamshtra, वृक्षम् tree, चिक्षेप shattered.

40016151.author: Translation
40016151.content: Angada who was endowed with great strength all his limbs bathed in blood and terrific valour took hold of a huge tree and shattered Vajradamshtra.

40016152.author: पदार्थः
40016152.content: राक्षसः Rakshasa, अपतन्तम् hurled, तंवृक्षम् that tree, दृष्टवा seeing, असम्भ्रान्तः not bewildered, बहुधा many, चिच्छेद pieces broken to, सोऽपि completed, मथितः shaken, भुवि ground, प्रापतत् fell.

40016152.author: Translation
40016152.content: That Rakshasa (Vajradamshtra) seeing the tree coming towards him was not bewildered. He shattered it into pieces, and it fell on the ground.

40016153.author: पदार्थः
40016153.content: प्लवगर्षभः bull of monkeys, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradamshtra's, तंविक्रमम् that valour, दृष्टवा seeing, विपुलम् vast, शैलम् hillock, प्रगृह्य seizing, चिक्षेपच broken, ननादच making loud sound.

40016153.author: Translation
40016153.content: The bull among monkeys, Angada seeing the valour of Vajradamshtra seizing a huge hillock hurled at the Rakshasa making loud sounds and breaking.

40016154.author: पदार्थः
40016154.content: वीर्यवान् valiant one, सः he, अपतन्तम् , तम् them, दृष्टवा looking, असम्भ्रान्तः not perplexed, गदापाणिः mace in hand, रथात् from chariot, आप्लुत्य leaping, पृथिव्याम् on ground, समतिष्ठत sat.

40016154.author: Translation
40016154.content: The valiant Rakshasa who was not perplexed with mace in hand leaping down the chariot looking (at the hillock hurled) sat on the ground.

40016155.author: पदार्थः
40016155.content: स he, आङ्गदेव by Angada, क्षिप्ता discharged, शिला hillock, गत्वा went, रणमूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तदा then, सचक्रकूबरम् the wheels and pole, साश्वम् totally, रथम् chariot, प्रममाथ shattered.

40016155.author: Translation
40016155.content: The hillock discharged by Angada went right in the forefront of the battle and shattered the chariot along with its wheels and pole.

40016156.author: पदार्थः
40016156.content: ततः then, सः he, अङ्गदः Angada, द्रुमभाषितम् adorned with trees, विपुलम् huge, अन्यत् other, शिखरम् peak, गृह्य seizing, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य on Vajradamshtra, शिरसि head, पातयामास hurled.

40016156.author: Translation
40016156.content: Then Angada seized a huge hillock adorned with trees hurled at Vajradamshtra.

40016157.author: पदार्थः
40016157.content: सःवज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, शोणितोद्गारी vomiting blood, मूर्छितः unconscious, अभवत् became, गदाम् mace, आलिङ् ग्य clasping, निश्श्वसन् breathing heavily, मुहूर्तम् for a while, मूढः senseless, अभवत् remained.

40016157.author: Translation
40016157.content: Vajradamshtra vomiting blood became unconscious and clasping his mace breathing heavily he remained senseless for a while.

40016158.author: पदार्थः
40016158.content: संलब्दसंज्ञः regaining senses, निशाचरः night ranger, परमक्रुद्धः extremely angry, अवस्थितम् stood firmly, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, वक्षोदेशे direction of the chest, गदया with mace, जघान attacked.

40016158.author: Translation
40016158.content: The night ranger regained his senses, extremely angry, stood firmly and attacked Angada, son of Vali on his chest with his mace.

40016159.author: पदार्थः
40016159.content: ततः then, गदाम् mace, त्यक्त्वा leaving off, तत्र there, मुष्टियुद्धम् duel fight, अवर्तत started, तौ they both, हरिराक्षसौ monkey and Rakshasas, उभौ both, तत्र there, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नतुः fought.

40016159.author: Translation
40016159.content: Then leaving off the mace, a dual fight started there between one another, the monkeys, and Rakshasas.

40016160.author: पदार्थः
40016160.content: प्रहारैः exhausted, जनितश्रमौ out of strain, रुधिरोद्गारिणौ spit out blood, तौ both, सुविक्रान्तौ very valiant, अङ्गारकबुधाविव like planets Angaraka and Budha (Mars and Mercury), बभूवतुः remained.

40016160.author: Translation
40016160.content: Exhausted by strain both very valiant fought like planets Angaraka and Budha and spit out blood.

40016161.author: पदार्थः
40016161.content: ततः then, परमतेजस्वी highly energetic, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, बहुपुष्प many flowers, फलाञ्चितम् and fruits, वृक्षम् trees, उत्पाट्य uprooted, स्थितवान् standing.

40016161.author: Translation
40016161.content: Then highly energetic, bull among Vanaras, Angada, uprooting a tree full of many flowers and fruits stood there.

40016162.author: पदार्थः
40016162.content: विपुलम् huge, शुभम् bright, किङ्किणीजालसञ्छन्नम् shield made of bull hide decorated with tiny bells, आर्षभंचर्म made with hide, चर्मणा hide, परिष्कृतम् encased, खडगंच sword also, जग्राह held.

40016162.author: Translation
40016162.content: (The Rakshasa seized) a huge bright sword, a shield decorated with tiny bells and sword encased in hide sheath.

40016163.author: पदार्थः
40016163.content: तदा then, जयकाङ् क्षिणौ desiring victory, कपिराक्षसौ monkey and Rakshasa, निर्दयम् passionately, चित्रान् wonderful, मार्गान् ways, चेरतुः struck, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नतुश्च harshly.

40016163.author: Translation
40016163.content: Then desiring victory both monkey and Rakshasa struck one another passionately in wonderful harsh ways.

40016164.author: पदार्थः
40016164.content: सास्त्रै: streaming, व्रणैः wounds, पुष्पितौ blossomed, किंशुकाविव Kimsuka like, शोभेताम् charming, युध्यमानौ in the battlefield, परिश्रान्तौ exhausted, जानुभ्याम् knees, अवनीम् on the ground, गतौ sat.

40016164.author: Translation
40016164.content: Their wounds streaming blood, exhausted in the battlefield, when they rested on their knees on the ground, they were like charming Kimsuka blossoms.

40016165.author: पदार्थः
40016165.content: कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among the monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण time of twinkling of the eyes दीप्ताक्षः eyes glowing, दण्डाहतः struck by staff, उरगःइव serpent like, उदतिष्ठत rose up.

40016165.author: Translation
40016165.content: Angada, the elephant among the monkeys rose up in the mere twinkling of eyes, like a serpent struck by staff glowing in his eyes.

40016166.author: पदार्थः
40016166.content: महाबलः mighty, वालिसूनुः Val['s son, सुधौतेन sharpened well, निर्मलेन stainless, खडगेन sword, अस्यवज्रदंष्ट्रस्य that Vajradamshtra's, महत् great, शिरः head, जघान lopped off.

40016166.author: Translation
40016166.content: Mighty son of Vali lopped off the great head of Vajradamshtra's with a sharpened stainless sword.

40016167.author: पदार्थः
40016167.content: रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य limbs bathed in blood, तस्य his, तत् that, शुभम् decorated, शिरः head, खडगहतम् destroyed by sword, सरोषपरिवृत्ताक्षम् eyeballs rolling, द्विधा cleft into two, पतितम् dropped, बभूव remained.

40016167.author: Translation
40016167.content: His (Vajradamshtra's) limbs bathed in blood, cut off by sword, eyeballs rolling cleft into two dropped down.

40016168.author: पदार्थः
40016168.content: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, भयमोहिताः deluded in fear, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, वध्यमानाः struck by monkeys, विषण्णवदनाः panic stricken, ह्रिया in shame, किञ्चित् heads bent, अवाङ्मुखाः faces, woebegone, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यद्रवन् fled.

40016168.author: Translation
40016168.content: Deluded with fear, the Rakshasas seeing Vajradamshtra killed by monkeys, panic stricken, heads bent in shame, faces woebegone fled to Lanka.

40016169.author: पदार्थः
40016169.content: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, भयमोहिताः deluded in fear, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, वध्यमानाः struck by monkeys, विषण्णवदनाः panic stricken, ह्रिया in shame, किञ्चित् heads bent, अवाङ्मुखाः faces, woebegone, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यद्रवन् fled.

40016169.author: Translation
40016169.content: Deluded with fear, the Rakshasas seeing Vajradamshtra killed by monkeys, panic stricken, heads bent in shame, faces woebegone fled to Lanka.

40016170.author: पदार्थः
40016170.content: वज्रधरप्रतापवान् equal to Indra in his valour, महाबलः mighty, सःवालिसूनुः that son of Vali, तम् them, निहत्य having killed, कपिसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of Vanara army, महितः great, त्रिदशैः Indra Lord of gods, आवृतः surrounded, सहस्रनेत्रःइव like thousand eyed, हर्षम् joy, जगाम became.

40016170.author: Translation
40016170.content: Mighty son of Vali, having killed Vajradamshtra, honoured in the midst of great Vanara army was joyful surrounded like the thousand eyed Indra, the Lord of gods. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुःपञ्चाशस्सर्गः This is the end of the fifty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
